blurb: The teaching attributed to Zarathustra: one Wise Lord (Ahura Mazda), the cosmic struggle of truth (asha) against the lie (druj), and individual judgment.

events.description: 17 hymns in Old Avestan traditionally attributed to Zarathustra himself — the oldest layer of the Avesta. They preach one Wise Lord, the choice between truth and the lie, and judgment after death. Dating is genuinely debated.
events.title: Gathas of Zarathustra

name: Zoroastrianism
